description: This is a PHP unit test class for testing the FormatWithBase64Encode class within the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin. The test primarily verifies that the method getFormattedValue correctly encodes a string using Base64 encoding.

classes.name: FormatWithBase64EncodeTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the FormatWithBase64Encode class. Contains setup for test environment and a test method to verify Base64 encoding of a string.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, loads fixture data, and instantiates the FormatWithBase64Encode object.

methods.name: testGetFormattedValue
methods.description: Tests that getFormattedValue correctly encodes the string 'Picture1' into its Base64 representation.
